title: Internet Connection Troubleshooting
content: Check the router power, WAN/Internet light, cables, and restart the router. If the Internet light remains red or off, further support may be required.

title: Billing and Outstanding Payment
content: Check the customer's billing status and payment history. If an outstanding amount exists, explain the amount due and available payment options.

title: Account Access Troubleshooting
content: Verify the customer's account status. Guide the customer through password reset or account recovery steps when appropriate.

title: Slow Internet Troubleshooting
content: Check the customer's plan, router status, connected devices, and network conditions. Run a speed test if available.
